```{r}
# Remove unwanted columns and omit missing values
data <- data1[, -1]
data <- na.omit(data)

# Define necessary column indices here

columns_omics <- 8 # ADD 1ST COLUMN WITH OMICS DATA HERE (ONLY ONE NUMBER)
columns_nonomics <- 7 # ADD LAST COLUMN WITH NON-OMICS DATA HERE (ONLY ONE NUMBER)
#columns_categoric <- 2 # ADD COLUMNS WITH CATEGORICAL DATA HERE (COULD BE SEVERAL NUMBERS OR RANGES)
columns_response <- 7 # ADD COLUMNS WITH RESPONSE DATA HERE (COULD BE SEVERAL NUMBERS OR RANGES)
columns_predictors <- 1:6 # ADD COLUMNS WITH PREDICTOR DATA HERE (COULD BE SEVERAL NUMBERS OR RANGES)
columns_predictors_x <- 1:6 # ADD COLUMNS WITH MAIN (NON-OMIC) PREDICTOR x_train_matrix DATA HERE, COUNTING ALL LEVELS OF ALL FACTORIZED VARIABLES (COULD BE SEVERAL NUMBERS OR RANGES)


# Define response and predictor columns based on data
response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]
predictor_cols_base <- colnames(data)[columns_predictors]


# Function to balance a dataset by undersampling the majority class

balance_data <- function(df, response_col) {
  minority <- df[df[[response_col]] == 1, ]
  majority <- df[df[[response_col]] == 0, ]
  n_samples <- nrow(minority)
  undersampled_majority <- majority %>%
    sample_n(size = min(nrow(majority), n_samples), replace = FALSE)
  balanced <- rbind(minority, undersampled_majority)
  return(balanced[sample(nrow(balanced)), ])  # Shuffle rows
}


# Function to balance a dataset with weights

compute_case_weights <- function(df, response_col) {
  n_pos <- sum(df[[response_col]] == 1)
  n_neg <- sum(df[[response_col]] == 0)
  total <- n_pos + n_neg
  weight_pos <- total / (2 * n_pos)
  weight_neg <- total / (2 * n_neg)
  weights <- ifelse(df[[response_col]] == 1, weight_pos, weight_neg)
  return(weights)
}


use_weights <- TRUE  # Set to TRUE to use weights instead of undersampling

```

## For loop to individually select significant predictor biomarkers for the binomial response variables in logistic regression handling class imbalance with undersampling of the majority class

AUC baseline: Performance of the logistic (binomial or multinomial) regression model without the selected biomarkers, only with the main predictors
AUC biomakrer: Performance of the logistic (binomial or multinomial) regression model including the selected biomarker as a significant predictor of the response
ANOVA: ANOVA of baseline model vs model with biomarker

Weights Affect Model Likelihoods Differently: glm() with weights applies weighted maximum likelihood estimation, meaning the likelihood values it computes are different from an unweighted model. The anova() function expects models to be directly comparable, but weighted and unweighted models don't have likelihoods on the same scale. This makes the likelihood-ratio test invalid in some cases, leading to NA in p-values. That is why instead of comparing weighted vs. unweighted models, ensure both models, the baseline and the full model with biomarker, use weights. This makes sure anova() compares models estimated in the same way.


Removed for loop over response_cols as they is only one which was used for the splitting of the data into training and test sets, which we used at the beginning of the code for both our individual marker selection loop and our elastic net marker selection loop!!! 

```{r results='asis', warning=FALSE}

# Load necessary libraries
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(pROC)
library(writexl)
library(caret)  # Required for stratified sampling
library(DT)

# Initialize lists to store the results
results_list <- list()
roc_storage <- list()
predictor_results <- list()


data$row_id <- 1:nrow(data)

# Create directory for Excel files if it doesn't exist
dir.create("Individually Selected Predictors", showWarnings = FALSE)

# Function to calculate NRI (Net Reclassification Improvement)
calculate_nri <- function(biomarker_probs,
                          baseline_probs,
                          actual_outcomes,
                          risk_cutoffs = c(0.1,0.2)) {

  categorize_risk <- function(prob, cutoffs){
    findInterval(prob, vec = c(-Inf, cutoffs, Inf))
  }

  baseline_risk <- categorize_risk(baseline_probs, risk_cutoffs)
  biomarker_risk <- categorize_risk(biomarker_probs, risk_cutoffs)

  reclassified <- biomarker_risk - baseline_risk

  events <- actual_outcomes == 1
  non_events <- actual_outcomes == 0

  correct_events <- sum(reclassified[events] > 0) / sum(events)
  incorrect_events <- sum(reclassified[events] < 0) / sum(events)

  correct_non_events <- sum(reclassified[non_events] < 0) / sum(non_events)
  incorrect_non_events <- sum(reclassified[non_events] > 0) / sum(non_events)

  (correct_events - incorrect_events) +
    (correct_non_events - incorrect_non_events)
}



##########################################################
######################## TODO ############################
##########################################################


###############################
##### Robustness threshold ####
###############################

##########################################################
############ Generate fixed train/test splits ############
##########################################################

n_seeds <- 50

min_frequency <- ceiling(0.80 * n_seeds)

splits <- vector("list", n_seeds)

for(seed in 1:n_seeds){

  set.seed(seed)

  splits[[seed]] <-
    initial_split(
      data,
      prop = 0.70,
      strata = data[[response_cols]]
    )

}


for(seed in 1:n_seeds){

  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Seed:",seed,"\n")
  cat("=========================\n")

  split <- splits[[seed]]

  train_raw <- training(split)
  test_data <- testing(split)
  
  # Loop through the columns of data_Biomarker

response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

baseline_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(response_col, "~", paste(predictor_cols_base, collapse = " + "))
)

# Create a single balanced training set
if (use_weights) {

  balanced_train_data <- train_raw

  balanced_weights <- compute_case_weights(
    balanced_train_data,
    response_col
  )

} else {

  balanced_train_data <- balance_data(
    train_raw,
    response_col
  )

  balanced_weights <- rep(1, nrow(balanced_train_data))
}

baseline_model_balanced <-
  glm(
    baseline_formula,
    family = binomial,
    data = balanced_train_data,
    weights = balanced_weights
  )

baseline_probs <-
  predict(
    baseline_model_balanced,
    newdata = test_data,
    type = "response"
  )

baseline_roc <-
  suppressMessages(
    roc(
      test_data[[response_col]],
      baseline_probs
    )
  )

baseline_auc <- round(auc(baseline_roc),3)

for(i in 2:ncol(data_Biomarker)){

  myBiomarker <- data_Biomarker[,i]

  temp <- cbind(data_noBiomarker,myBiomarker)

  colName <- names(data_Biomarker)[i]

  names(temp)[ncol(temp)] <- "Biomarker"

  predictors <- predictor_cols_base[
    predictor_cols_base != response_col
  ]

  predictor_cols <- c(predictors,"Biomarker")

  formula <-
    as.formula(
      paste(
        response_col,
        "~",
        paste(predictor_cols,collapse=" + ")
      )
    )

  temp_train <- train_raw

  temp_test <- test_data

  biomarker_values <- pull(myBiomarker)

  temp_train$Biomarker <-
    biomarker_values[
      match(temp_train$row_id,data$row_id)
    ]

  temp_test$Biomarker <-
    biomarker_values[
      match(temp_test$row_id,data$row_id)
    ]

  model_data <- balanced_train_data

  case_weights <- balanced_weights

  model_data$Biomarker <-
    biomarker_values[
      match(model_data$row_id,data$row_id)
    ]

  glm_biomarker <-
    glm(
      formula,
      family=binomial,
      data=model_data,
      weights=case_weights
    )

  biomarker_probs <-
    predict(
      glm_biomarker,
      newdata=temp_test,
      type="response"
    )

  biomarker_roc <-
    suppressMessages(
      roc(
        temp_test[[response_col]],
        biomarker_probs
      )
    )

  auc_biomarker <- round(
    auc(biomarker_roc),
    3
  )

  anova_result <-
    anova(
      baseline_model_balanced,
      glm_biomarker,
      test="Chisq"
    )

  anova_glm <-
    round(
      anova_result$`Pr(>Chi)`[2],
      3
    )

  summary_model <- summary(glm_biomarker)
  
  coef_df <- as.data.frame(summary_model$coefficients)

  coef_df$Predictor <- rownames(coef_df)

  coef_df$Seed <- seed

  coef_df$Biomarker <- colName

  coef_df$Response <- response_col

  coef_df$FDR <-
    p.adjust(
      coef_df$`Pr(>|z|)`,
      method = "fdr"
    )

predictor_results[[length(predictor_results)+1]] <-
  coef_df

  estimate_biomarker <-
    round(
      summary_model$coefficients["Biomarker","Estimate"],
      3
    )

  p_value_biomarker <-
    round(
      summary_model$coefficients["Biomarker","Pr(>|z|)"],
      3
    )

  fdr_values <-
    round(
      p.adjust(
        summary_model$coefficients[,"Pr(>|z|)"],
        method="fdr"
      ),
      3
    )

  fdr_biomarker <- fdr_values["Biomarker"]

  nri_value <-
    calculate_nri(
      biomarker_probs=biomarker_probs,
      baseline_probs=baseline_probs,
      actual_outcomes=temp_test[[response_col]]
    )

  results_list[[length(results_list)+1]] <-
    data.frame(

      Seed = seed,

      Biomarker = colName,

      Response = response_col,

      Estimate = estimate_biomarker,

      Pr = p_value_biomarker,

      FDR = fdr_biomarker,

      AUC_baseline = baseline_auc,

      AUC_biomarker = auc_biomarker,

      Delta_AUC = auc_biomarker - baseline_auc,

      ANOVA_p_value = anova_glm,

      NRI = round(nri_value,3),

      Significant =
        p_value_biomarker < 0.1,

      stringsAsFactors = FALSE

    )

  roc_storage[[paste(seed, response_col, colName, sep="_")]] <-
    list(

      roc = biomarker_roc,

      auc = auc_biomarker,

      seed = seed,

      biomarker = colName,

      response = response_col

    )

}

}   # ---------------- END OF 50-SEED LOOP ----------------


###############################
#### Combine all results ######
###############################

results <- bind_rows(results_list)

predictor_results <- bind_rows(predictor_results)

###############################
#### Summary across seeds #####
###############################

summary_results <-
  results %>%
  group_by(Response, Biomarker) %>%
  summarise(

    Mean_Estimate = mean(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),
    SD_Estimate = sd(Estimate, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_Pr = mean(Pr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Median_Pr = median(Pr, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_FDR = mean(FDR, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_AUC_baseline = mean(AUC_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower95_AUC_baseline =
      quantile(AUC_baseline, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper95_AUC_baseline =
      quantile(AUC_baseline, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_AUC_biomarker = mean(AUC_biomarker, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower95_AUC_biomarker =
      quantile(AUC_biomarker, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper95_AUC_biomarker =
      quantile(AUC_biomarker, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_Delta_AUC = mean(Delta_AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower95_Delta_AUC =
      quantile(Delta_AUC, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper95_Delta_AUC =
      quantile(Delta_AUC, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

    Median_ANOVA = median(ANOVA_p_value, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_NRI = mean(NRI, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lower95_NRI =
      quantile(NRI, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    Upper95_NRI =
      quantile(NRI, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),

    Significant_frequency = sum(Significant),
    Significant_percent = round(100 * mean(Significant), 1),

    .groups = "drop"

  )

###############################
##### Predictor summary #######
###############################

predictor_summary <-

predictor_results %>%

group_by(
    Response,
    Biomarker,
    Predictor
) %>%

summarise(

    Mean_Estimate =
        mean(Estimate),

    SD_Estimate =
        sd(Estimate),

    Mean_OR =
        exp(mean(Estimate)),

    Lower95_OR =
        quantile(exp(Estimate), 0.025),

    Upper95_OR =
        quantile(exp(Estimate), 0.975),

    Mean_Pr =
        mean(`Pr(>|z|)`),

    Median_Pr =
        median(`Pr(>|z|)`),

    Mean_FDR =
        mean(FDR),

    Significant_frequency =
        sum(`Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05),

    Significant_percent =
        100 * mean(`Pr(>|z|)` < 0.05),

    FDR_Significant_frequency =
        sum(FDR < 0.05),

    FDR_Significant_percent =
        round(100 * mean(FDR < 0.05), 1),

    .groups = "drop"

) %>%

mutate(

    Mean_OR =
        sprintf(
            "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
            Mean_OR,
            Lower95_OR,
            Upper95_OR
        )

) %>%

select(

    -Lower95_OR,
    -Upper95_OR

)


###############################
##### Select Top 5 ############
###############################

robust_results <-
summary_results %>%
filter(

  Significant_frequency >= min_frequency,
  Mean_Delta_AUC > 0

) %>%
arrange(

  desc(Significant_frequency),
  desc(Mean_Delta_AUC),
  desc(Mean_NRI),
  desc(Mean_AUC_biomarker),
  Mean_Pr

)

###############################
#### Display version ##########
###############################

robust_results_display <-

robust_results %>%

mutate(

  Mean_AUC_baseline =
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_AUC_baseline,
      Lower95_AUC_baseline,
      Upper95_AUC_baseline
    ),

  Mean_AUC_biomarker =
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_AUC_biomarker,
      Lower95_AUC_biomarker,
      Upper95_AUC_biomarker
    ),

  Mean_Delta_AUC =
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_Delta_AUC,
      Lower95_Delta_AUC,
      Upper95_Delta_AUC
    ),

  Mean_NRI =
    sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      Mean_NRI,
      Lower95_NRI,
      Upper95_NRI
    )

) %>%

select(

  Response,
  Biomarker,

  Mean_AUC_baseline,
  Mean_AUC_biomarker,
  Mean_Delta_AUC,

  Median_ANOVA,

  Mean_NRI,

  Significant_frequency,
  Significant_percent

)

top5 <-
robust_results %>%
slice_head(n = 5)

cat("<details><summary style='font-size:1.8em;'>Robust Biomarkers Across 50 Random Stratified 70/30 Splits</summary><br>")

    roc_obj$roc,
    main = paste0(
      biomarker,
      "\nRepresentative ROC (Seed ",
      closest_seed,
      ", AUC = ",
      sprintf("%.3f", roc_obj$auc),
      ")"
    )
  )

}

cat("</details>")

##### Clean-up ################
###############################

train_raw$row_id <- NULL
test_data$row_id <- NULL
data_noBiomarker$row_id <- NULL

rm(results_list)
rm(roc_storage)
```

## Obtaining the estimates and p-values of all predictors included in the baseline model together with the selected significant biomarker

```{r results='asis'}

# Load necessary libraries for table display

###############################

dir.create(

)

sorted_results <-

    desc(Significant_frequency),

for(response_var in unique(sorted_results$Response)){

  cat(paste0(
    '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',

  response_results <-

    biomarker <- response_results$Biomarker[i]

    model_name <- paste(

    )

    predictors_df <-

  predictor_summary %>%

  select(

        round(response_results$Upper95_AUC_biomarker[i], 3),
        ")<br>",

        "<b>Mean ΔAUC:</b> ",
        round(response_results$Mean_Delta_AUC[i], 3),
        " (95% empirical interval: ",
        round(response_results$Lower95_Delta_AUC[i], 3),
        "–",
        round(response_results$Upper95_Delta_AUC[i], 3),
        ")<br>",

        "<b>Mean NRI:</b> ",
        round(response_results$Mean_NRI[i], 3),
        " (95% empirical interval: ",
        round(response_results$Lower95_NRI[i], 3),
        "–",
        round(response_results$Upper95_NRI[i], 3),
        ")<br><br>"

      )

    )

    ####################################################
    #### Save Excel ####################################
    ####################################################

    file_name <-

      paste0(

        "Models with Individually Selected Biomarkers/",

        gsub(
          "[^[:alnum:]_]",
          "_",
          model_name
        ),

        ".xlsx"

      )

    write_xlsx(
      predictors_df,
      path = file_name
    )

    cat(

      paste0(

        '<a href="',

        file_name,

        '" download>Download averaged predictor table (.xlsx)</a><br><br>'

      )

    )

    ####################################################
    #### HTML table ####################################
    ####################################################

    kable(

      predictors_df,

      format = "html",

      digits = 3,

      caption = paste(
        "Average predictor coefficients across",
        n_seeds,
        "random stratified 70/30 train/test splits"
      ),

      align = "c"

    ) %>%

      kable_styling(

        bootstrap_options = c(
          "striped",
          "hover",
          "condensed",
          "responsive"
        ),

        full_width = FALSE,

        position = "center"

      ) %>%

      column_spec(
        1,
        bold = TRUE
      ) %>%

      row_spec(
        0,
        bold = TRUE,
        color = "white",
        background = "black"
      ) %>%

      print()

    cat("</div></details><br>")

  }

  cat("</div></details><br>")

}


```


A categorical variable that for example contains values from 1 to 4 in the original dataset will only show levels 2 to 4 in the output of the model. This suggests that the reference level in the model is set to level 1, meaning the coefficients for levels 2 to 4 represent differences compared to level 1. When using a categorical variable in model regression, R automatically treats one of the levels as the reference category, comparing all other levels against it. This is standard practice for handling categorical predictors in regression models.

## Performing Elastic Net and obtaining the cross-validation plots


We also calculate here the performance of the model generated by machine learning, as well as the performance of the model using the same matrix ustilised for machine learning and the same machine learning algorithm. This will not result in any "chosen" variable since we are forcing the machine learning algorithm to use the predictors that we consider mandatory, but it will give us a performance of the "machine learning - baseline model" that we can compare with the performance of the models generated by machine learning when freely choosing biomarkers within our omic dataset. These will indicate how good the machine learning model predictions are, specially compared with a baseline model without biomarkers from our omics data.


Removed for loop over response_cols as they is only one which was used for the splitting of the data into training and test sets, which we used at the beginning of the code for both our individual marker selection loop and our elastic net marker selection loop!!! 


```{r results='asis'}


############################################################
################ Elastic Net initialization ################
############################################################

library(glmnet)
library(tidymodels)
library(kableExtra)
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)


############################################################
################ TODO User settings ########################
############################################################


response_cols <- colnames(data)[columns_response]

exclude_columns <- c(response_cols, "row_id")


alpha_values <- seq(0.05,1,0.05)

nfolds_values <- c(5,10,20)


############################################################
################ Storage ###################################
############################################################

results_list <- list()

coef_list <- list()

selected_variables_list <- list()

roc_storage <- list()

warnings <- character()

############################################################
############ Store cv.glmnet objects ########################
############################################################

cv_models <- list()

############################################################
############### De novo refitting storage ##################
############################################################

refit_results_list <- list()

refit_coef_list <- list()

refit_roc_storage <- list()

############################################################
################ Warning handler ###########################
############################################################

capture_warning <- function(w){

  warnings <<-
    c(
      warnings,
      conditionMessage(w)
    )

  invokeRestart("muffleWarning")

}


############################################################
############## Start warning capture ########################
############################################################

withCallingHandlers({

for(seed in 1:n_seeds){

  cat("\n=========================\n")
  cat("Seed:", seed, "\n")
  cat("=========================\n")


  ##########################################################
  ########### Reuse predefined stratified split#############
  ##########################################################

  response_col <- response_cols[[1]]

  split <- splits[[seed]]

  train_raw <- training(split)

  test_data <- testing(split)

  ##########################################################
  ########### Balance / Weights ############################
  ##########################################################

  if(use_weights){

    train_data <- train_raw

    sample_weights <-
      compute_case_weights(
        train_data,
        response_col
      )

  }else{

    train_data <-
      balance_data(
        train_raw,
        response_col
      )

    sample_weights <-
      rep(
        1,
        nrow(train_data)
      )

  }

  ##########################################################
  ########### Design matrices ##############################
  ##########################################################

  x_train <-
    select(
      train_data,
      -all_of(response_col),
      -all_of(exclude_columns)
    )

  y_train <-
    train_data[[response_col]]

  x_test <-
    select(
      test_data,
      -all_of(response_col),
      -all_of(exclude_columns)
    )

  y_test <-
    test_data[[response_col]]

  if(exists("factor_columns") &&
     length(factor_columns)>0){

    x_train_matrix <-
      model.matrix(
        ~.-1,
        data=x_train,
        contrasts.arg=contrasts_list
      )

    x_test_matrix <-
      model.matrix(
        ~.-1,
        data=x_test,
        contrasts.arg=contrasts_list
      )

  }else{

    x_train_matrix <-
      model.matrix(
        ~.-1,
        data=x_train
      )

    x_test_matrix <-
      model.matrix(
        ~.-1,
        data=x_test
      )

  }

  predictor_names <-
    colnames(
      x_train_matrix
    )

  ##########################################################
  ################ Baseline model ##########################
  ##########################################################

  baseline_matrix <-
    x_train_matrix[
      ,
      columns_predictors_x
    ]

  baseline_cvfit <-
    cv.glmnet(

      baseline_matrix,

      y_train,

      family="binomial",

      alpha=0,

      standardize=FALSE,

      weights=sample_weights

    )
          #########################################################################################
          #################################### TODO ###############################################
          #########################################################################################
  baseline_lambda <-
    baseline_cvfit$lambda.min

  baseline_model <-
    glmnet(

      baseline_matrix,

      y_train,

      family="binomial",
      
      alpha = 0,

      lambda=baseline_lambda,

      standardize=FALSE,

      weights=sample_weights

    )

  baseline_predictions <-

    predict(

      baseline_model,

      newx=x_test_matrix[
        ,
        columns_predictors_x
      ],

      type="response"

    )

  baseline_auc <-

    as.numeric(

      auc(

        roc(

          y_test,

          baseline_predictions,

          quiet=TRUE

        )

      )

    )

  ##########################################################
  ########## Loop over nfolds ##############################
  ##########################################################

  for(nfolds_val in nfolds_values){


    ########################################################
    ########### Loop over alpha ############################
    ########################################################

    for(alpha_val in alpha_values){

      penalty.factor <-
        rep(
          1,
          ncol(x_train_matrix)
        )

      penalty.factor[
        columns_predictors_x
      ] <- 0
      
      
      ########################################################
      ################ Fit Elastic Net #######################
      ########################################################

      cvfit <-

        cv.glmnet(

          x_train_matrix,

          y_train,

          family = "binomial",

          alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val,

          penalty.factor = penalty.factor,

          standardize = FALSE,

          weights = sample_weights

        )

      lambda_min <- cvfit$lambda.min

      lambda_1se <- cvfit$lambda.1se
      
      ########################################################
      ############ Store CV model ############################
      ########################################################

      cv_key <-

        paste(

          response_col,

          alpha_val,

          nfolds_val,

          seed,

          sep = "_"

        )

      cv_models[[cv_key]] <- cvfit

      ########################################################
      ################ Final model ############################
      ########################################################

      model <-

        glmnet(

          x_train_matrix,

          y_train,

          family = "binomial",
          
          alpha = alpha_val,
          #########################################################################################
          #################################### TODO ###############################################
          #########################################################################################
          lambda = lambda_min,

          penalty.factor = penalty.factor,

          standardize = FALSE,

          weights = sample_weights

        )

      ########################################################
      ################ Test predictions ######################
      ########################################################

      predictions <-

        predict(

          model,

          newx = x_test_matrix,

          type = "response"

        )

      roc_obj <-

        suppressMessages(

          roc(

            y_test,

            as.numeric(predictions)

          )

        )

      auc_value <-

        as.numeric(

          auc(roc_obj)

        )

      delta_auc <-

        auc_value -
        baseline_auc

      ########################################################
      ######## Number of selected predictors #################
      ########################################################

      coef_vector <-

        as.vector(

          coef(model)

        )

      coef_names <-

        rownames(

          coef(model)

        )

      selected_predictors <-

        sum(

          coef_vector[-1] != 0

        )

      ########################################################
      ######## Store model performance #######################
      ########################################################

      results_list[[length(results_list)+1]] <-

        data.frame(

          Seed = seed,

          Response = response_col,

          Alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val,

          Lambda_min = lambda_min,

          Lambda_1se = lambda_1se,

          Baseline_AUC = baseline_auc,

          ElasticNet_AUC = auc_value,

          Delta_AUC = delta_auc,

          Selected_predictors = selected_predictors,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE

        )
      
            ########################################################
      ######## Store coefficients ############################
      ########################################################

      coef_df <-

        data.frame(

          Seed = seed,

          Response = response_col,

          Alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val,

          Variable = coef_names,

          Coefficient = coef_vector,

          Selected = coef_vector != 0,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE

        )

      coef_list[[length(coef_list)+1]] <-

        coef_df

      ########################################################
      ######## Store selected variables ######################
      ########################################################

      selected_df <-

        coef_df %>%

        filter(

          Variable != "(Intercept)",

          Selected

        ) %>%

        transmute(

          Seed,

          Response,

          Alpha,

          nfolds,

          Variable

        )

      selected_variables_list[[length(selected_variables_list)+1]] <-

        selected_df
      
      
      ########################################################
      ############### De novo logistic refit #################
      ########################################################

      predictor_vars <-

        selected_df$Variable

      ########################################################
      ######## Convert dummy variables back to factors ########
      ########################################################

      if(exists("factor_columns") &&
        length(factor_columns) > 0){

        predictor_vars <-

          unique(

            sapply(

              predictor_vars,

              function(var){

                for(factor_col in factor_columns){

                  if(grepl(

                    paste0("^",factor_col),

                    var

                  )){

                    return(factor_col)

                  }

                }

                return(var)

              }

            )

          )

      }

      ########################################################
      ########### Build formulas #############################
      ########################################################

      main_predictors <-

        colnames(data)[columns_predictors]

      baseline_formula <-

        as.formula(

          paste(

            response_col,

            "~",

            paste(

              main_predictors,

              collapse=" + "

            )

          )

      )

      ########################################################
      ########### Full model formula #########################
      ########################################################

      all_predictors <-

        unique(

          c(

            main_predictors,

            predictor_vars

          )

        )

      full_formula <-

        as.formula(

          paste(

            response_col,

            "~",

            paste(

              all_predictors,

              collapse=" + "

            )

          )

        )
      
      ########################################################
      ################ Fit GLMs ###############################
      ########################################################

      if(use_weights){

        baseline_glm <-

          glm(

            baseline_formula,

            data=train_data,

            family="binomial",

            weights=sample_weights

          )

        full_glm <-

          glm(

            full_formula,

            data=train_data,

            family="binomial",

            weights=sample_weights

          )

      }else{

        baseline_glm <-

          glm(

            baseline_formula,

            data=train_data,

            family="binomial"

          )

        full_glm <-

          glm(

            full_formula,

            data=train_data,

            family="binomial"

          )

      }
      
      
      ########################################################
      ################ Test-set predictions ##################
      ########################################################

      baseline_predictions <-

        predict(

          baseline_glm,

          newdata = test_data,

          type = "response"

        )

      full_predictions <-

        predict(

          full_glm,

          newdata = test_data,

          type = "response"

        )

      ########################################################
      ################ Calculate AUC ##########################
      ########################################################

      baseline_auc_glm <-

        as.numeric(

          auc(

            roc(

              test_data[[response_col]],

              baseline_predictions,

              quiet = TRUE

            )

          )

        )

      full_auc_glm <-

        as.numeric(

          auc(

            roc(

              test_data[[response_col]],

              full_predictions,

              quiet = TRUE

            )

          )

        )
      
      
      ########################################################
######## Store refitted ROC ############################
########################################################

refit_roc_obj <-

  roc(

    test_data[[response_col]],

    full_predictions,

    quiet = TRUE

  )

refit_roc_storage[[

  paste(

    seed,

    response_col,

    alpha_val,

    nfolds_val,

    sep = "_"

  )

]] <-

  list(

    roc = refit_roc_obj,

    auc = full_auc_glm,

    seed = seed,

    response = response_col,

    alpha = alpha_val,

    nfolds = nfolds_val

  )

      ########################################################
      ################ Delta AUC ##############################
      ########################################################

      delta_auc_glm <-

        full_auc_glm -

        baseline_auc_glm

      ########################################################
      ################ Likelihood ratio test ##################
      ########################################################

      anova_result <-

        anova(

          baseline_glm,

          full_glm,

          test = "Chisq"

        )

      anova_p <-

        if(

          nrow(anova_result) >= 2

        ){

          anova_result$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]

        }else{

          NA_real_

        }

      ########################################################
      ################ Net Reclassification ###################
      ########################################################

      nri_value <-

        calculate_nri(

          biomarker_probs = full_predictions,

          baseline_probs = baseline_predictions,

          actual_outcomes = test_data[[response_col]]

        )

      ########################################################
      ################ Store model performance ################
      ########################################################

      refit_results_list[[

        length(refit_results_list)+1

      ]] <-

        data.frame(

          Seed = seed,

          Response = response_col,

          Alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val,

          Baseline_AUC = baseline_auc_glm,

          Refit_AUC = full_auc_glm,

          Delta_AUC = delta_auc_glm,

          ANOVA_p = anova_p,

          NRI = nri_value,

          Number_predictors =

          length(

          setdiff(

          all_predictors,

          main_predictors

          )

          ),

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE

        )
      
      
      ########################################################
      ############ Store model coefficients ##################
      ########################################################

      tidy_model <-

        broom::tidy(

          full_glm

        ) %>%

        mutate(

          OR = exp(estimate),

          FDR = p.adjust(

            p.value,

            method = "fdr"

          ),

          Seed = seed,
  
          Response = response_col,

          Alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val

        )

      ########################################################
      ######## Store coefficient table ########################
      ########################################################

      refit_coef_list[[

        length(refit_coef_list)+1

      ]] <-

        tidy_model

      ########################################################
      ######## Representative ROC ############################
      ########################################################

      roc_storage[[

        paste(

          seed,

          response_col,

          alpha_val,

          nfolds_val,

          sep = "_"

        )

      ]] <-

        list(

          roc = roc_obj,

          auc = auc_value,

          seed = seed,

          response = response_col,

          alpha = alpha_val,

          nfolds = nfolds_val

        )

      ########################################################
      ######## Optional progress message #####################
      ########################################################

    }   # end alpha loop

  }   # end nfolds loop

}   # end seed loop

}, warning = capture_warning)
      
      
      
############################################################
################ Combine all results ########################
############################################################

results <-

  bind_rows(results_list)

coefficients_df <-

  bind_rows(coef_list)

selected_variables <-

  bind_rows(selected_variables_list)


############################################################
############### Variable selection frequency ###############
############################################################


selection_frequency <-

selected_variables %>%

group_by(

    Response,

    Alpha,

    nfolds,

    Variable

) %>%

summarise(

    Selection_frequency =

        100 * n()/n_seeds,

    .groups="drop"

)


############################################################
############ Combine de novo refitting results #############
############################################################

refit_results <-

  bind_rows(

    refit_results_list

  )

refit_coefficients <-

  bind_rows(

    refit_coef_list

  )



############################################################
############### De novo summary ############################
############################################################

refit_summary <-

  refit_results %>%

  group_by(

    Response,

    Alpha,

    nfolds

  ) %>%

  summarise(

    Mean_Baseline_AUC =

      mean(

        Baseline_AUC,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Lower95_Baseline =

      quantile(

        Baseline_AUC,

        0.025,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Upper95_Baseline =

      quantile(

        Baseline_AUC,

        0.975,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Mean_Refit_AUC =

      mean(

        Refit_AUC,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Lower95_Refit =

      quantile(

        Refit_AUC,

        0.025,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Upper95_Refit =

      quantile(

        Refit_AUC,

        0.975,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Mean_Delta_AUC =

      mean(

        Delta_AUC,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),
    
    Lower95_Delta =

  quantile(

    Delta_AUC,

    0.025,

    na.rm = TRUE

  ),

Upper95_Delta =

  quantile(

    Delta_AUC,

    0.975,

    na.rm = TRUE

  ),

    Significant_ANOVA =

      mean(

        !is.na(ANOVA_p) & ANOVA_p < 0.05

      ) * 100,

    Mean_NRI =

      mean(

        NRI,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),
    
    Lower95_NRI =

      quantile(

        NRI,

        0.025,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Upper95_NRI =

      quantile(

        NRI,

        0.975,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

    Mean_Selected =

      mean(

        Number_predictors,

        na.rm = TRUE

      ),

SD_Selected =

  sd(

    Number_predictors,

    na.rm = TRUE

  ),

    .groups = "drop"

  ) %>%

  arrange(

    desc(

      Mean_Refit_AUC

    ),

    desc(

      Mean_Delta_AUC

    )

  )








refit_coefficients_summary <-

  refit_coefficients %>%

  group_by(

    Response,

    Alpha,

    nfolds,

    term

  ) %>%

  summarise(

    Mean_Beta = mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),

    SD_Beta = sd(estimate, na.rm = TRUE),

    Mean_OR = exp(mean(estimate, na.rm = TRUE)),

    Lower95_OR = exp(
      quantile(
        estimate,
        0.025,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),

    Upper95_OR = exp(
      quantile(
        estimate,
        0.975,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),

    Median_p = median(
      p.value,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Mean_FDR = mean(
      FDR,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    .groups = "drop"

  )




############################################################
################ Performance summary ########################
############################################################

summary_results <-

results %>%

group_by(

  Response,

  Alpha,

  nfolds

) %>%

summarise(

  Mean_AUC =

    mean(
      ElasticNet_AUC,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Lower95_AUC =

    quantile(
      ElasticNet_AUC,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Upper95_AUC =

    quantile(
      ElasticNet_AUC,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Mean_Baseline_AUC =

    mean(
      Baseline_AUC,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Lower95_Baseline =

    quantile(
      Baseline_AUC,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Upper95_Baseline =

    quantile(
      Baseline_AUC,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Mean_Delta_AUC =

    mean(
      Delta_AUC,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Lower95_Delta =

    quantile(
      Delta_AUC,
      0.025,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Upper95_Delta =

    quantile(
      Delta_AUC,
      0.975,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Mean_Lambda_min =

    mean(
      Lambda_min,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  SD_Lambda_min =

    sd(
      Lambda_min,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Mean_Lambda_1se =

    mean(
      Lambda_1se,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  SD_Lambda_1se =

    sd(
      Lambda_1se,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  Mean_Selected =

    mean(
      Selected_predictors,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  SD_Selected =

    sd(
      Selected_predictors,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

  .groups = "drop"

)

############################################################
################ Sort models ###############################
############################################################

summary_results <-

summary_results %>%

arrange(

  desc(Mean_AUC),

  desc(Mean_Delta_AUC),

  Mean_Selected

)



############################################################
################ Display warnings ##########################
############################################################

warnings <- unique(warnings)

if (length(warnings) > 0) {

  cat(
    '<details><summary style="font-size:1.2em;"><strong>',
    length(warnings),
    ' unique warning(s) encountered during the analysis',
    '</strong></summary>'
  )

  cat('<div style="margin-left:20px;margin-top:10px;">')

  for(warn in warnings){

    cat("<p>", warn, "</p>")

  }

  cat("</div></details><br>")

} else {

  cat(
    "No warnings were encountered during the analysis.<br>"
  )

}


```



## Obtaining the optimal lambda and the R2 (performance) of each regression model under different alpha values in elastic net

Here is shown the previously described performance of the model generated by machine learning, as well as the performance of the "machine learning basemodel". 

```{r results='asis'}

############################################################
################ Elastic Net summary tables ################
############################################################

library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)
library(dplyr)

dir.create(
  "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

############################################################
################ Loop over responses ########################
############################################################

      )

    ########################################################
############ HTML version of summary table #############
########################################################

response_summary_html <-

  response_summary %>%

  mutate(

      "%.3f ± %.3f",

    ########################################################

    ))
    
    refit_table_html <-

  refit_table %>%

  mutate(

    ),

    ),

    ),

    NRI = sprintf(

    ),

    ),

    )

  ) %>%

  select(

    kable(

        "Refitted logistic model performance summary for",

        response_col,

        "(nfolds =",

        nfolds_val,

        ")"

      ),

      align = "c"

    ) %>%

      kable_styling(

        bootstrap_options = c(

          "striped",

          "hover",

          "condensed",

          "responsive"

        ),

        full_width = FALSE,

        position = "center"

      ) %>%

      row_spec(

        0,

        bold = TRUE,

        color = "white",

        background = "black"

      ) %>%

      print()
    
    
    
    
    ########################################################
    ############ Refitted coefficient summary ##############
    ########################################################

    coef_summary <-

      refit_coefficients_summary %>%

      filter(

        Response == response_col,

        nfolds == nfolds_val

      ) %>%
  
      left_join(

        selection_frequency %>%

          rename(term = Variable) %>%

          select(
            Response,
            Alpha,
            nfolds,
            term,
            Selection_frequency
          ),

        by = c(
          "Response",
          "Alpha",
          "nfolds",
          "term"
        )

      ) %>%

      mutate(

        Selection_frequency =
          ifelse(term == "(Intercept)",
                NA,
                Selection_frequency),

        Beta = ifelse(

          is.finite(Mean_Beta) & is.finite(SD_Beta),

          sprintf("%.3f \u00b1 %.3f", Mean_Beta, SD_Beta),

          "—"

        ),

OR = ifelse(

  is.finite(Mean_OR),

  sprintf(
    "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
    Mean_OR,
    Lower95_OR,
    Upper95_OR
  ),

  "—"

),

        Median_p = round(Median_p, 4),

        Mean_FDR = round(Mean_FDR, 4)

      ) %>%

      relocate(

        Selection_frequency,

        .after = term

      ) %>%
      
      rename(

  Predictor = term,

  `Selection (%)` = Selection_frequency,

  `β ± SD` = Beta,

  `Odds Ratio` = OR,

  `Median p` = Median_p,

  `Mean FDR` = Mean_FDR

) %>%

      select(

        Response,
        Alpha,
        nfolds,
        Predictor,
        `Selection (%)`,
        `β ± SD`,
        `Odds Ratio`,
        `Median p`,
        `Mean FDR`

      ) %>%

      arrange(

        Alpha,

        desc(`Selection (%)`),

        Predictor
  
      )
    
    
      
    coef_file <-

      paste0(

        "Machine Learning Models comparison and summary/",

        response_col,

        "_nfolds_",

        nfolds_val,

        "_Refitted_coefficients_summary.xlsx"

      )

    write_xlsx(

      coef_summary,

      coef_file

    )

    cat(paste0(
      '<br><a href="',
      coef_file,
      '" download>Download Refitted Coefficient Summary as Excel</a><br><br>'
    ))

    kable(

      coef_summary,

      format = "html",

      digits = 3,

      caption = paste(

        "Refitted logistic model coefficient summary for",

        response_col,

        "(nfolds =",

        nfolds_val,

        ")"

      ),

      align = "c"

    ) %>%

      kable_styling(

        bootstrap_options = c(

          "striped",

          "hover",

          "condensed",

          "responsive"

        ),

        full_width = FALSE,

        position = "center"

      ) %>%

      row_spec(

        0,

        bold = TRUE,

        color = "white",

        background = "black"

      ) %>%

      print()

    ########################################################
    ################ Close nfolds panel #####################
    ########################################################

    cat("</div></div></div><br>")

  }

  ##########################################################
  ################ Close response panel #####################
  ##########################################################

  cat("</div></div></div><br>")

}
```

## Obtaining all the non-zero coefficients of the predictors chosen by elastic net for each alpha value and refitting the regression model de-novo using those predictors. 

A regression model will be generated de-novo with the standard regression, using the predictors with non-zero coefficients, in a process called refitting of the model. That de-novo model or refitted model will be compared by ANOVA with the baseline model generated with the standard regression. These models are different from the previous ones as they are generated with the typical regression instead of with elastic net ML, and now the machine learning algorithm is not used to perform predictions to obtain the performance of the models. If elastic net did not select any candidate biomarkeer, the de-novo (refitted) regression model = baseline model, so ANOVA p-value = NA and performance (R2 for linear regression) of baseline model and de-novo generated (refitted) model will be the same.

The first table will show the coefficients of the candidate biomarkers chosen within our omics data by elastic net as a suitable predictor of the response variables. The coefficients of predictors selected with the penalty.factor will always appear, and correspond to the predictors of the baseline model. Only when elastic net selects candidate biomarkers from our omics data, their coefficients will be also shown. 

The second table will show the estimates of those predictors after being used in a refitted model using the standard regression algorithm, not the machine learning one, and that is why significance of those predictors (p-values) can also be shown.

```{r results='asis'}


############################################################
############ Representative Elastic Net models #############
############################################################

library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(writexl)

dir.create(
  "Representative Elastic Net Models",
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

############################################################
############ Identify representative models ################
############################################################

representative_models <-

  refit_results %>%

  group_by(

    Response,

    Alpha,

    nfolds

  ) %>%

  mutate(

    Mean_Refit_AUC = mean(
      Refit_AUC,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    Distance =
      abs(
        Refit_AUC -
        Mean_Refit_AUC
      )

  ) %>%

  arrange(
    Distance,
    .by_group = TRUE
  ) %>%

  slice_head(n = 2) %>%

  ungroup()

############################################################
################ Loop over responses #######################
############################################################

for(response_col in unique(representative_models$Response)){

cat(paste0(
'<div class="panel panel-default">',
'<div class="panel-heading">',
'<h4 class="panel-title">',
'<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#Representative_',response_col,'">',
'Representative models for Response: ',response_col,
'</a>',
'</h4>',
'</div>',
'<div id="Representative_',response_col,'" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
'<div class="panel-body">'
))

############################################################
################ Loop over nfolds ##########################
############################################################

for(nfolds_val in sort(unique(representative_models$nfolds))){

cat(paste0(
'<div class="panel panel-default">',
'<div class="panel-heading">',
'<h5 class="panel-title">',
'<a data-toggle="collapse" href="#Representative_',
response_col,'_',nfolds_val,'">',
'nfolds = ',nfolds_val,
'</a>',
'</h5>',
'</div>',
'<div id="Representative_',response_col,'_',nfolds_val,
'" class="panel-collapse collapse">',
'<div class="panel-body">'
))

############################################################
################ Loop over alpha ###########################
############################################################

for(alpha_val in sort(unique(representative_models$Alpha))){

cat(paste0(
'<details><summary><strong>Alpha = ',
alpha_val,
'</strong></summary><br>'
))

rep_models <-

representative_models %>%

filter(

Response==response_col,

nfolds==nfolds_val,

Alpha==alpha_val

)

if(nrow(rep_models)==0){

cat("No representative models found.<br><br>")

}else{

##########################################################
############ Loop over representative seeds ###############
##########################################################

for(i in seq_len(nrow(rep_models))){

this_seed <- rep_models$Seed[i]

cat(paste0(
"<h4>Representative model ",
i,
" (Seed ",
this_seed,
")</h4>"
))

cat(paste0(
"<b>Refitted AUC:</b> ",
round(rep_models$Refit_AUC[i],3),
"<br>"
))

cat(paste0(
"<b>Mean refitted AUC:</b> ",
round(rep_models$Mean_Refit_AUC[i],3),
"<br>"
))

cat(paste0(
"<b>Distance from mean:</b> ",
round(rep_models$Distance[i],5),
"<br><br>"
))



##########################################################
############ Cross-validation plot ########################
##########################################################

cv_key <-

  paste(

    response_col,

    alpha_val,

    nfolds_val,

    this_seed,

    sep = "_"

  )

cvfit <- cv_models[[cv_key]]

if(!is.null(cvfit)){

  op <- par(no.readonly = TRUE)

  par(

  mar = c(5, 5, 5.5, 2),   # plot margins
  oma = c(0, 0, 0, 0)      # extra outer top margin

  )

  plot(cvfit)

  title(

    main = paste(

      "Elastic Net Cross-validation Plot",
      
      cex.main = 1.0

    )

  )

  par(op)

}else{

  cat(

    "<b>Cross-validation plot not available.</b><br><br>"

  )

}

cat("<br>")



##########################################################
############ Refitted ROC curve ###########################
##########################################################

roc_key <-

  paste(

    this_seed,

    response_col,

    alpha_val,

    nfolds_val,

  )

roc_info <- refit_roc_storage[[roc_key]]

if(!is.null(roc_info)){

    main = paste(

    )

  )

}

##########################################################
######## Elastic Net coefficient table ####################
##########################################################

elastic_table <-

coefficients_df %>%

filter(

paste0(

kable(

format="html",

digits=3,

caption=paste(

),

kable_styling(

bootstrap_options=c(

),

full_width=FALSE,

row_spec(

0,

bold=TRUE,

) %>%

print()

##########################################################
######## Refitted logistic coefficient table ##############
##########################################################

refit_table <-

refit_coefficients %>%

filter(

refit_file <-
```
